text: A word problem! A farm has 2,450 chickens. 875 chickens are sold. How many chickens are left?
Chickens are taken away, so we subtract.
First, estimate: 2,450 is about 2,500, and 875 is about 900. 2,500 minus 900 is 1,600.
Now the exact answer: 2,450 minus 875 is 1,575. It is close to our estimate, so it makes sense!
